childNodes.textContent: Capture the real devhost devtools UI.

This page restores the deterministic demo surface used by the marketing recorder. It exposes stable DOM
            targets, a mocked control plane, and a browser rrweb capture API for Playwright-driven recording runs.

Alt-click the cards below to showcase annotation selection, then submit an agent handoff through the
                injected composer.
Move the launch command rail below the health summary and tighten the spacing.
Align the worker-service warning with the rest of the capture grid before the next take.
Alt-right-click this card to open the real devtools source navigation menu and launch an editor session.
The managed route is now live and both routed services are healthy.
Bring the overlay into view and pause long enough for the minimap and status panels to settle.
Focus the source card, launch an editor session, and let the terminal tray animate into place.
Use the route reveal button to transition from the pending route state to the live route state.
Keep enough vertical content here to make slow scroll gestures visible in the final rrweb recording.
